name: 115.简

basedOn.note: User device immediately exposed a JavaScript compile error when opening File Management after Test18. Test19 is an emergency rollback of File Management to the device-validated Test17 V9 module while preserving the standalone playback-history page for later re-integration.

rootCause: Test18 injected the video-favorite longClick hook into the serialized File Management rule with an unbalanced property/object closure, producing the device error '在属性列表的后面缺少 }'.
fix: restore 115FileManage exactly to the known-good Test17 file_manage_v9.js snapshot
keep the standalone 115PlayHistory page module installed but do not patch playback/favorite hooks into File Management in this hotfix
accept both broken Test18 and known-good Test17 as direct upgrade bases
do not touch search, offline center, account center, recycle bin, login, magnet focusMode or file-operation protocols
tradeoff: Recent-play automatic capture and long-press video favorite entry from File Management are temporarily disabled until they are reintroduced with a smaller exported helper and syntax gate.
deviceResult: User confirmed File Management recovered normally after Test19.
